0022600157.text: The Lakers host the Raptors in their 7th game of the season, sitting at 4-2 overall, 2-1 at home, 1st in the Pacific and 7th in the West after a one-game losing streak, while Toronto is 3-2 with a 1-1 road record, 3rd in the Atlantic (2 games back), 5th in the East and also on a one-game losing streak. Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Lakers won both 2025-26 meetings 2-0, most recently a 110-93 win in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
